gitCommit.subject: fix(tests): stabilize flaky integration tests (Neon session instability) (#1407)
gitCommit.body:
fix(tests): stabilize flaky integration tests (Neon session instability) (#1407)

* fix(tests): stabilize flaky integration tests against Neon endpoint instability

Call waitForBranchReady() after branch creation to ensure the endpoint is
active before running migrations. Add retry logic with exponential backoff
for Neon API calls, align hook/setup timeouts, tune connection pool settings,
and add a CI retry loop as a safety net.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(tests): increase hookTimeout to 120s and fix eslint config for *.config.ts

Aligns Vitest hookTimeout with the actual setup duration needed for
Neon branch creation, endpoint readiness, and migration deployment.
Also adds *.config.ts to eslint ignorePatterns (matching existing *.config.js).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------
